scopeNote: Every population, flow, infrastructure and spend input used by the Workstream A market assessment, geographic prioritisation and partial TAM/SAM/SOM model. Model outputs are included as DERIVED inputs so that the narrative documents are fully traceable to this file.

scenarios.method: Three scenarios (LOW / MID / HIGH) applied identically to every vessel-based figure. The band is driven by two unknowns: the share of the base that plausibly buys navigation/connectivity electronics (0.35 / 0.50 / 0.65) and the annual addressable spend per eligible vessel (EUR 75 / 142 / 209). MID is arithmetic, not a forecast.
scenarios.noShareAssumption: No arbitrary market-share percentage is applied anywhere. SOM is bounded by assumed delivery capacity (installers x installs per month x months), not by a claimed share of the SAM.

inputs.metric: Spanish moored-boat plus Portuguese registered-craft base proxy
inputs.notes: 133,400 Spanish berths + 85,000 Portuguese registered craft. These are DIFFERENT proxies (capacity vs registry) and the sum must be read as an order-of-magnitude base, not a fleet count. Spanish trailer-launched and dry-stored craft are excluded; Portuguese inactive registered craft are included.

inputs.metric: Beachhead base proxy: Galician berths plus documented northern-Portuguese berths
inputs.notes: 10,500 Galicia + 1,088 documented Northern Portugal. Excludes every Portuguese port without a retrieved berth count.

inputs.metric: Share of the berth/registry base plausibly buying navigation and connectivity electronics (LOW)
inputs.notes: Scenario assumption, not a measurement. Rationale: personal watercraft and craft below 6 m are 70% of new registrations and a lower but unknown share of berths, because small craft are frequently trailered or dry-stored; berth-based capacity therefore skews larger, but no published berth-length distribution was found.

inputs.metric: Share of the base plausibly buying navigation and connectivity electronics (MID)
inputs.notes: Midpoint of the LOW/HIGH band; chosen because berths skew larger than registrations but a majority of European recreational craft remain small open boats.

inputs.metric: Share of the base plausibly buying navigation and connectivity electronics (HIGH)
inputs.notes: Upper scenario; would require most berth holders to operate electronics-relevant craft.

inputs.metric: Annual software subscription spend per eligible vessel (LOW)
inputs.notes: Scenario anchor only: the low end of the annual navigation-subscription prices recorded by the programme's benchmark work on 2026-10-30 (EUR 34.99 regional chart subscription). Not a measured average spend.

inputs.metric: Annual software subscription spend per eligible vessel (HIGH)
inputs.notes: Scenario anchor only: the high end of published consumer navigation/weather subscription prices recorded by the programme on 2026-10-30. Not a measured average and not evidence that a vessel pays this.

inputs.metric: Annualised hardware spend per eligible vessel (LOW)
inputs.notes: EUR 240 gateway-class retail price point divided by an assumed 6-year replacement cycle. Both the price point and the cycle are assumptions; no observed equipment-replacement interval exists in this evidence set.

inputs.metric: Annualised hardware spend per eligible vessel (HIGH)
inputs.notes: EUR 360 receiver-class retail price point divided by an assumed 6-year replacement cycle.

inputs.metric: Delivery capacity assumed for MAREA in the beachhead (installers)

inputs.metric: Delivery capacity assumed per installer

inputs.metric: SOM units in the first 12 months (capacity-bounded)
inputs.notes: Installers x installs per month x 12: 1x2x12=24; 2x3x12=72; 3x4x12=144. Capacity-bound, NOT a market share and not a demand estimate. Recorded as ASSUMED, not DERIVED, because it rests on scenario parameters for which no observed value exists.

inputs.metric: SOM year-1 value (LOW / MID / HIGH)
inputs.notes: 24 x EUR 275 = 6,600; 72 x EUR 542 = 39,024; 144 x EUR 808 = 116,352, where 275/542/808 are the LOW/MID/HIGH year-1 hardware-plus-software basket per installation (240-659 hardware + 35-149 subscription). Recorded as ASSUMED, not DERIVED, because it rests on scenario parameters for which no observed value exists.
